commands.observed: The API suite includes the feature-flag-off behavior and passed 22 tests.

documented_controls: GRAPH_WORKFLOW_CANARY_USER_IDS restricts Graph writes to an explicit user cohort.
Non-canary requests return LEGACY_WORKFLOW_ROUTE_REQUIRED when a canary list is configured.
Rollback preserves old graph factories, checkpoint tables, domain facts and Outbox rows.
limitations: This snapshot has no complete internal legacy workflow route; a 503 canary response or 404 disabled response is not a local legacy fallback.
No live Redis canary publication or production success-rate/latency/cost comparison was run.
Canary thresholds in the runbook are operator-set acceptance thresholds, not measured results.
